_source: How GameCove starts a ROM with each setup. EmuDeck: ES-DE picks the command (the system's default from es_systems.xml, the system's alternative emulator from the gamelist's <alternativeEmulator>, or the game's own <altemulator>), and when that command's %EMULATOR_x% has an EmuDeck launcher script, the script in <Emulation>/tools/launchers/ runs instead of the bare emulator, with ES-DE's arguments, the way EmuDeck's own Steam ROM Manager parsers start games (configs/steam-rom-manager/userData/userConfigurations.json in https://github.com/dragoonDorise/EmuDeck, GPL-3.0; scripts in tools/launchers/, each passes its arguments on to the emulator). 'args' replaces ES-DE's arguments where the script handles them differently: supermodel.sh joins all its arguments into one, vita3k.sh reads the .psvita file itself. RetroDECK: its own CLI starts a game and applies ES-DE's alternative emulators itself (functions/retrodeck.sh and functions/run_game.sh in https://github.com/RetroDECK/RetroDECK, GPL-3.0): flatpak run net.retrodeck.retrodeck -s <system> <game>. ES-DE on its own: ES-DE's command with its find rules, nothing in between.
